create_interface_config: create an InterfaceConfig object with a slab, adsorbates, solvent, and ions for molecular simulation
create_interface_on_sites: create solvent and ion interface configurations on top of existing adsorbate-slab atoms objects
create_packmol_atoms: create packed solvent and ion atoms in a unit cell volume using packmol
run_packmol: run the packmol executable with a given input file to pack molecules
randomize_coords: randomize atom coordinates within a unit cell by setting center of mass to a random position
